name: NBI Industrial Finance Company Ltd
about: NBI Industrial Finance Co. Ltd. is a  Non-Banking Financial Company(NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India.  The Company is engaged mainly in investment in shares in securities & financial activity.  The Company has long-term orientation in its investments and mainly invests in listed equities.  [1][2]
keyPoints:
Investment Policy
The Co. has an investment policy wherein it invests in those securities which have easy liquidity, better yield, and potential for price appreciation in the medium to long run. [1]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.22 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.62% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.31% over last 3 years.
